collection.description: A villager's favorite carved spoon has gone missing at dinner, and no other spoon is right.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has eaten every meal for years with the same carved wooden spoon. It has a little chip on the handle and fits (subject.his/her) hand perfectly. Tonight it is gone. (subject) has looked everywhere. The bowl of stew is getting cold, and there are plenty of other spoons, and none of them are right.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) picks up an ordinary spoon and eats. It's fine. The stew is fine. Everything is fine. It's just a little bit wrong. The next morning the good spoon turns up in the water jar, and (subject) decides not to ask (subject.him/her)self how it got there.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) turns the hut upside down. (friend) comes to help and, after a long search, finds the spoon in the water jar, where (subject) put it that morning after stirring something. (subject) holds it like a lost friend. The stew is cold by now. (subject) eats it anyway and says it's the best stew (subject.he/she) has ever had.
